title: How do we adapt to the cold?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why do some people cope with cold weather much better than others?
Which is harder to adapt to: extreme cold or extreme heat?
Do you think people living in cold countries become mentally tougher, or is that a stereotype?
What changes do you make to your routine when the weather becomes very cold?
If energy became much more expensive, how could households stay warm without using as much heating?
